description: Canonical asset manifest for Lost Valley batch art generation, validation, review, and runtime export.

style_profile.summary: Premium 1990s animated action-cartoon paleontology adventure with heavy expressive ink contours, saturated flat color masses, hard-edged cel shading, strong silhouettes, and high slot-machine readability.
positive_traits: clear separation between major color regions
visual punch at small symbol size

batches.label: Base Game Premium and Feature Trigger Symbols

mining_pick.subject: mining pick
mining_pick.composition: single rugged field pick centered on square canvas, three-quarter view, immediately readable silhouette
mining_pick.background: simple charcoal or slate field with restrained earth texture
mining_pick.palette_notes: dark steel, weathered wood, restrained warm earth accents

canteen.subject: expedition canteen
canteen.composition: single rugged metal field canteen centered, simple three-quarter view
canteen.background: muted dark gray or olive field
canteen.palette_notes: desaturated metal, olive, dark leather strap accents

compass.subject: expedition compass
compass.composition: large readable round compass, near-front view, centered
compass.background: dark slate field with subtle expedition texture
compass.palette_notes: aged brass, cream dial, dark ink, restrained red needle
special_constraints: dial need not contain readable microtext

excavation_brush.subject: archaeology excavation brush
excavation_brush.composition: single broad-bristle field brush at slight diagonal, centered
excavation_brush.background: muted charcoal or warm stone field
excavation_brush.palette_notes: wood handle, tan bristles, dark outline
special_constraints: do not include dust cloud large enough to obscure silhouette

journal.subject: weathered expedition field journal
journal.composition: single closed leather field journal centered, clear rectangular book silhouette, slight three-quarter view
journal.background: muted charcoal or warm stone field
journal.palette_notes: warm brown leather, brass clasp, parchment edges, dark ink contours
special_constraints: do not make it a magical spellbook

scientist.subject: female field scientist with notebook
scientist.composition: waist-up or three-quarter portrait, practical expedition clothes, notebook clearly visible, confident focused expression
scientist.background: simple muted jungle or olive field
scientist.palette_notes: khaki, olive, warm skin tones, dark hair or clearly separated hair mass

helicopter.subject: expedition helicopter
helicopter.composition: single rugged utility helicopter, clean side or three-quarter view, fully contained within square
helicopter.background: deep blue sky or muted mountainous backdrop
helicopter.palette_notes: olive expedition body, dark rotor, restrained yellow highlights
special_constraints: all rotor blades contained in safe area

satellite_map.subject: satellite expedition map
satellite_map.composition: folded or mounted map with obvious topographic/satellite imagery and technological expedition cues
satellite_map.palette_notes: earth map colors, blue water, restrained cyan technology accents
special_constraints: must read as satellite/navigation intelligence, not generic treasure map

jeep.subject: rugged expedition jeep
jeep.composition: single off-road expedition jeep, three-quarter front view, fully contained
jeep.palette_notes: olive drab vehicle, warm headlights, dark tires

supply_crate.subject: rugged expedition supply crate
supply_crate.composition: single reinforced equipment crate centered, square readable silhouette, slightly angled
supply_crate.palette_notes: olive metal, worn bronze corners, canvas straps, dark ink

trex_tooth.subject: large fossilized Tyrannosaurus rex tooth
trex_tooth.composition: single thick fossil tooth, centered, slightly angled, fractured fossil texture
trex_tooth.palette_notes: ivory fossil, tan, dark brown creases
special_constraints: must read as tooth, not horn

raptor_claw.subject: fossilized raptor sickle claw
raptor_claw.composition: single strongly curved sickle claw, side profile, centered
raptor_claw.background: deep warm earth or muted rust
raptor_claw.palette_notes: dark fossil brown, bone tan highlights
special_constraints: must look dramatically more curved than trex tooth
do not depict ordinary bird talon

eggshell.subject: broken prehistoric dinosaur eggshell fragment
eggshell.composition: single substantial broken shell fragment with clear concavity and jagged fracture
eggshell.palette_notes: eggshell cream, tan, speckled dark marks

pterosaur_feather.subject: rare preserved pterosaur feather-like specimen
pterosaur_feather.composition: single elongated feather-like fossil specimen, diagonal for strong silhouette
special_constraints: must not look like a modern colorful bird feather

horn_fragment.subject: broken fossil horn fragment
horn_fragment.composition: single thick horn section with clear broken base, centered

fossil_valley.subject: round stone containing a prehistoric fern leaf fossil
fossil_valley.composition: round fossil stone centered, clearly visible prehistoric fern or pinnate leaf impression
fossil_valley.palette_notes: gray stone, cool pale fossil imprint, deep blue background

predator_valley.subject: dinosaur footprint impressed into red rock
predator_valley.composition: large three-toed theropod footprint centered in cracked red stone
predator_valley.palette_notes: brick red, dark crimson, charcoal cracks, burnt orange highlights

golden_amber.subject: valuable golden amber with visible prehistoric insect inclusion
golden_amber.composition: single large amber specimen centered, insect silhouette clearly visible inside
golden_amber.background: warm burnt orange or dark amber field
golden_amber.palette_notes: honey gold, rich orange, yellow-white highlight, dark insect

expedition_camp_wild.subject: expedition camp wild
expedition_camp_wild.composition: compact jungle campsite with visible tent, supply crates or equipment, and bright central campfire
expedition_camp_wild.background: dense dark forest fills the square
expedition_camp_wild.palette_notes: deep forest green, canvas tan, warm orange fire, dark blue-black shadows
special_constraints: scene must remain readable at symbol size
no baked WILD text unless explicitly requested later

nesting_eggs.subject: cluster of dinosaur eggs in a nest
nesting_eggs.composition: several large speckled dinosaur eggs grouped in a compact nest, centered and highly readable
nesting_eggs.palette_notes: eggshell cream, moss green, warm straw, dark ink

small_fossil.subject: small ordinary fossil embedded in stone
small_fossil.composition: modest fossil imprint in a single stone chunk, centered

amber.subject: amber specimen
special_constraints: simpler and less premium than golden_amber unless gameplay later specifies otherwise

footprints.subject: dinosaur footprints
footprints.composition: two or three large readable dinosaur tracks crossing earth or stone
footprints.palette_notes: earth brown, rust, dark track impressions

fern.subject: prehistoric fern
fern.composition: single large fern frond or compact prehistoric fern cluster
fern.palette_notes: yellow-green, fern green, deep green shadows

river.subject: lost valley river
river.composition: compact river scene with strong S-curve or diagonal of turquoise water between jungle banks
river.palette_notes: turquoise, deep blue, forest green, stone gray

nest.subject: dinosaur nest with eggs
nest.composition: compact nest containing multiple large prehistoric eggs, centered
nest.palette_notes: eggshell cream, olive, straw brown, deep green
special_constraints: both nest and eggs clearly visible
not a generic modern bird nest

dinosaur_egg.subject: single dinosaur egg fossil discovery
dinosaur_egg.composition: large speckled dinosaur egg centered on excavation ground, readable egg silhouette
dinosaur_egg.background: Fossil Valley excavation earth or stone
dinosaur_egg.palette_notes: eggshell cream, tan speckles, stone gray, dark ink

bone_cluster.subject: cluster of exposed fossil bones
bone_cluster.composition: several substantial fossil bones partially exposed in earth
